name: pulse-e2e
description: Playwright E2E harness for pulse — Phase 8.2. Critical-path coverage on the user-facing surfaces of the live uptime monitor: the landing smoke (production-CSP gate), the live status board (one SSE connection, real state), the demo-incident arc (the headline — synchronized down/summary/banner/toast, then recovery), the ADR-007 auth boundary + demo gating, the incidents view, the redacted public status page, and keyboard / reduced-motion smoke. Runs against the BUILT + SERVED stack on :3081 (web) + :3080 (NestJS web + worker); a deployed URL can be targeted via BASE_URL.
